owner_request: 2026-10-08 继续做 v3 分层吧 (Notion #14 sub-task: v3 分层 - 按冲击强度 / 量比 / 同向比例看后续收益)
question: Within one fixed event set, do stronger sync shocks (larger joint z, larger joint volume ratio, wider alt breadth) continue more over the next 4-24h than weaker ones, and does the ordering hold in both periods?
single_variable: Conditioning only: events, outcomes and paired controls are v2's own rows for the loosest v2 config; each event is assigned to a tercile of one strength feature at a time. Data, features, universe, cost, controls and the 2025 split are unchanged.

features.strength: min(|btc_z|, |eth_z|) at the event bar (z = bar return / RMS of the previous 96 bar returns)
features.volume: min(btc_vr, eth_vr) at the event bar (volume / median of the previous 96 bar volumes); recomputed with v1.causal_features on the same BTC-indexed bars
features.breadth: share of the month's top-50 alts moving with the shock in the event bar (v2 events.csv)

bins: terciles per feature, timeframe and side; edges from events before select_before only, frozen and applied to later events

primary.read: top-minus-bottom tercile paired excess (net minus control) per feature, in each period; positive in both periods = the feature orders the outcome
